subject: Aaron Olapade and Anna Callahan Candidate Introduction
overview: Speakers introduced candidates Aaron Olapade and Anna Callahan to the community, highlighting their respective focuses on educational justice and data-driven governance.

items.title: Opening Remarks
items.summary: Wendy Miller Olapade welcomed attendees and spoke to the candidates' personal commitment to community service and democracy.

items.title: Candidate Endorsements
items.summary: A resident endorsed Aaron Olapade for his dedication to the Medford school system and Anna Callahan for her engineering background and research-oriented platform.
